invariants.rationale: Per the Javadoc, -1 and greater are meaningful values for button.
button likely never takes Integer.MIN_VALUE as a user-provided button code.
button is an int, so must be within int range; this states the upper bound explicitly.
Per the Javadoc, -1 means 'every button' and 0,1,... are for specific buttons.
It is common in GUI libraries for mouse button codes to be 0 (left), 1 (right), 2 (middle), so this bound is plausible.
